We present Kierston, a city-scale simulation engine, and KierstonBench, a benchmark that tests these capabilities against known simulated events. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. items.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
items.summary: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. items.summary: Dialectal Arabic speech recognition remains constrained by the scarcity of dialect-resolved transcribed speech despite the abundance of web audio. We introduce GigaSpeech 3, a corpus of 39,000 hours and 10 million weakly transcribed speech segments covering Algerian, Egyptian, Iraqi, Saudi, and Syrian Arabic. Starting from 60 hours of manual transcription per dialect, we train labeling models using speech-recognition-biased self-supervised learning and apply them to dialect-matched web audio. While raw videos offer an abundant and dynamic source of visual knowledge, transforming them into precise instruction data remains highly challenging. items.summary: Software development sessions often involve several unfinished tasks rather than one issue carried through to completion. As coding agents take on repository-level development, they need to recover an earlier task's requirements and partial progress after intervening work. items.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback. items.summary: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation. As advanced text-to-image (T2I) models have reached a practically usable level of multilingual text generation, we argue that this capability can be transferred to IIMT and present FlowTranslator. items.summary: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. items.summary: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. items.title: Transformer 架构还能咋改？严骏驰团队提供两条思路 | CNCC 2026
items.summary: 训练算力节省1/3。 作者丨张璐 编辑丨 张驰 增加参数、扩展专家数量、投入更多训练数据，是大模型提升能力的常见路径。但对于算力和数据资源有限的高校团队，沿着这些方向持续扩大规模并不容易。 在现有 Transformer 架构之上寻找其他扩展维度，是上海交通大学人工智能学院教授严骏驰，在前不久的CNCC 2026演讲中分享的研究思路。 在题为《大模型新架构探索：JTok & xHC》的报告中，严骏驰介绍了两项工作：JTok 为 token 引入可学习的参数表，通过查表和逐元素运算调制模型更新；xHC 则扩展残差流，以稠密读取、稀疏写回的方式提高模型容量。 两项研究都关注一个问题：新增容量能否以较低的额外计算代价，带来持续的训练收益。 严骏驰也讨论了这些方法的实际限制：小规模实验中的优势能否在更大规模上保持，训练算力的节省如何与推理延迟、访存开销相权衡，以及系统工程如何影响架构创新的效果。 以下为演讲整理。雷峰网 01 在现有架构上， 寻找新的扩展维度 今天分享的是我们在大模型新架构方面的一些探索。把它称为“新架构”，可能有一点夸大，实际上主要是在现有架构上做调整和改进。 为什么没有直接去做颠覆性的架构？一方面，我们没有那么多算力和能力；另一方面，即使把架构大幅修改，也未必能在工业界真正用起来。现在从底层硬件、驱动、算子，到上层模型软件，整个生态都沿着 Transformer 展开。…

items.title: 小孩子看稍微暴力血腥一点的电影真的影响很大么
items.summary: 不到该看的年龄，却看了，昆汀接受采访的时候，说他就是这样长大的，他的妈妈不会太限制他观影，所以同龄的孩子不能看的电影他在很小的时候就看过，从小看电影的量就很大。后来不也成为出名的导演有所成就了么。相同类型的还有电影某种物质的导演科拉莉法尔雅。 还有印象就是亚当桑德勒的人生遥控器里，讲他的小孩子已经在看断手断脚找分尸的剧情了，所以有此一问，小孩子看稍微暴力血腥一点的电影真的影响很大么 重点来了，我有一个朋友。他家里小孩 6 岁，他爱看动作电影、好莱坞大片，经常出现一些打斗、暴力的场面，娃有的时候会跟着一起看。当小孩面看的当然不是 B 级片、cult 片，就是普通的战争打斗、功夫格斗。如果现在不适合让他一起看，那几岁适合。 要知道，我们可是从小看《聊斋》《黑太阳 731 》《 XX 功纪录片》长大的啊。。。

items.title: 第一次相亲结束了，果然和网上说的一模一样啊。
items.summary: 前情提要： [/t/1253104](/t/1253104) 上次发了帖子后，我尝试了和对方聊天，然后想着周末约着出去玩。 之前对方说对我没什么看法，我以为可以聊聊然后继续约着见面。 但连续两三天，都是我给对方说点什么，对方隔七八个小时或者第二天才回复，回复也就是几个字。我再傻也知道这没什么沟通的必要了，只是我不理解既然不想回复，之前直接说不合适不就好了，为啥要说：“对我没什么看法”呢？是因为要给父母有个交代吗？ 以前我以为网上相亲那些视频里面，什么女生慢热将男生挂在半空中都是玩梗呢，现在我才知道原来现实里真有这样的。 我知道自己远远达不到让别人倒追的地步，但这种言行不一的行为还是让我大开眼界。 --- 之后和家里人说了情况，家里人也算是不催我了。但我妈后续的一些话又让我很是无语： 男的结婚有好处所以都急着结婚，女的结婚是吃亏所以都不急，想多挑挑。 我满脑子问号，问我妈这个理论从何谈起，她说男的将女的娶到家里，家里多了个人，又是给生孩子做家务啥的，也不能上班没有经济来源，肯定都想结婚。 我简直无话可说，我会做饭，和我相亲的女生还不会做饭呢，生孩子这也不都是两个人的孩子吗，怎么就好像专门给男人生的一样，再说了结婚不能上班没有经济来源这是什么说法，谁不想让家里多一份收入来源啊，这还是 2026 年吗？ 当然我知道我要是和她说这些，肯定又会吵起来，所以我就应付了过去。 唉，有的时候我真的…
